name: Potentially Suspicious WDAC Policy File Creation
description: Detects suspicious Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC) policy file creation from abnormal processes that could be abused by attacker to block EDR/AV components while allowing their own malicious code to run on the system.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Administrators and security vendors could leverage WDAC, apply additional filters as needed.
query: file.path:*\\Windows\\System32\\CodeIntegrity\\* AND (NOT ((process.executable:(*\\Microsoft.ConfigurationManagement.exe OR *\\WDAC\ Wizard.exe OR *C\:\\Program\ Files\\PowerShell\\7\-preview\\pwsh.exe OR *C\:\\Program\ Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe OR *C\:\\Windows\\System32\\dllhost.exe OR *C\:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell_ise.exe OR *C\:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe OR *C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\dllhost.exe OR *C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell_ise.exe OR *C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe)) OR ((winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*ConvertFrom\-CIPolicy\ \-XmlFilePath* AND winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*\-BinaryFilePath\ *) OR winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*CiTool\ \-\-update\-policy* OR (winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*Copy\-Item\ \-Path* AND winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*\-Destination*)) OR process.executable:System))
